d:
This work of art was first released back in 2002 and now, it has finally been translated 24 whole years later! I'm not actually much of a fan of all the urine but I still loved this series so much for the feminization story in the middle.

I decided to localize some of the sex sounds - like changing "kyaaa" to "eeeek" because, quite honestly, some of these squeals sound weird as hell when transliterated. I also took a few liberties with a few lines in order to make it a bit funnier because this story is RIDICULOUS, but largely, I've kept the meaning intact.
